```{r}
master<- read_csv("../data/processed/master_dataset.csv")
mutate(rural_urban = factor(rural_urban, levels = c("Rural", "Urban")))

rural <- master %>% filter(rural_urban == "Rural")
urban <- master %>% filter(rural_urban == "Urban")

cat("Master loaded:", nrow(master), "rows\n")
cat("Rural:", nrow(rural), "| Urban:", nrow(urban), "\n")
